blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.
blocks.zh: 视频语言模型(VLMs)优于视觉识别,但与因果推理相搏. 目前的评价有缺陷:多选择QA允许快捷,开放式QA缺乏强势的自动评价. 我们引入了Causal chain Crowth(CCG),这是一种新颖的任务,模型必须生成连接因果的中间事件的顺序. 这种结构化的设置需要真正的推理,并能够可靠地自动打分. 伴随这项任务的还有两个相辅相成的衡量标准:SODA-Embedding,它对照一个参考标准衡量生成链的语义匹配;Causal-QA,它通过询问该链是否包含重建叙述所需的具体因果关系来探究链的因果关系. 我们提供两套测试:SF20K-CC,对20部短片进行手动附加说明的诊断;CMD-CC,从音频描述中衍生出来的电影剪辑基准. 我们的分析表明,最新水平的VLM与叙事因果关系理解相抗争,经常产生幻觉或忽略关键事件. 为了解决这一问题,我们利用综合奖励,将格式奖励、SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA的准确性结合起来,对VLMs和GRPO进行微调,显示比强基线有重大改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding what happens in a video is only part of the story. True video comprehension requires reasoning about why events unfold the way they do, tracing the causal mechanisms that connect an inciting incident to its outcome. This form of narrative causality is central to how humans understand stories, plan actions, and learn from observation. Yet, despite the remarkable progress of recent Video-Language Models (VLMs) Google DeepMind (2025) ; Team (2025) ; Tang et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) on tasks ranging from video question answering Fu et al. (2025) ; Nagrani et al. (2025) ; Chandrasegaran et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Mangalam et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2024) to dense video captioning Yang et al. (2023) ; Krishna et al. (2017) and object tracking Pătrăucean et al. (2023) , their ability to reason about causality remains largely untested, in part because we lack the right tools to measure it.
blocks.zh: 了解视频中发生的事情只是故事的一部分. 真实的视频理解需要推理事件为何会发展成这样, 这种形式的叙事因果关系,对于人类如何理解故事,规划行动,从观察中吸取教训至关重要. 然而,尽管最近视频语言模型取得了显著进展, Google DeepMind(2025);Team(2025);Tang等人(2025);Zhang等人(2025b),任务范围从视频问题回答Fu等人(2025);Nagrani等人(2025);Chandrasegaran等人(2024);Wang等人(2025a);Mangalam等人(2023);Li等人(2024);密集视频字幕Yang等人(2023);Krishna等人(2017)和物体跟踪Pătrăucan等人(2023),他们关于因果关系的理性能力基本上仍未经过测试,部分原因是我们缺乏适当的测量工具.

blocks.en: The core difficulty lies in evaluation. The two dominant paradigms each fall short for causal reasoning. Multiple-choice QA (MCQA) Xiao et al. (2021) ; Wu et al. (2021) ; Nagrani et al. (2025) ; Lu et al. (2025) ; Luo et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2024b) ; Chen et al. (2025) is easy to score but easy to game: with only a handful of options, models exploit superficial cues rather than reason Foss et al. (2025) . Dense Video Captioning (DVC) Yang et al. (2023) ; Krishna et al. (2017) requires open-ended generation, but its metrics fall short: temporal-localization metrics (tIoU, F1) ignore semantic content, while n-gram metrics (CIDEr, METEOR, SODA) capture surface word overlap and miss whether the narrative is causally coherent. We thus lack a benchmark that is both complex enough to require genuine causal reasoning and structured enough to score automatically.
blocks.zh: 核心困难在于评价。 两个主导范式各自不足以进行因果推理. 多选择QA(MCQA) Xiao等人(2021年);Wu等人(2021年);Nagrani等人(2025年);Lu等人(2025年);Luo等人(2025年); Chen等人(2024年b); 陈等人(2025年)容易得分,但容易游戏:由于只有少数选择,模型利用的是肤浅的暗示而不是理性Foss等人(2025年). Dense Video Caption (DVC) Yang et al. (2023); Krishna et al. (2017) 需要开放式的生成,但其度量衡很短:时间定位度量衡(tIoU,F1)忽略了语义内容,而n-gram度量衡(CIDer,METEOR,SODA)则捕捉到表层词重叠,错失叙述是否因果一致性. 因此,我们缺乏一个既复杂又需要真正因果推理的基准,而且其结构足以自动得分。

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce a new task: Causal Chain Generation (CCG) . As illustrated in Figure , given a video, a start event, and an end event, the model must generate the sequence of intermediate events that causally bridges the two. By requiring open-ended generation of a structured sequence, CCG avoids the shortcut problem of MCQA while enabling automatic evaluation, something that free-form open-ended QA cannot reliably achieve. We accompany this task with two complementary evaluation metrics. SODA-Embedding extends the SODA metric Fujita et al. (2020) by replacing n-gram matching with semantic embeddings, shifting the focus from temporal localization to semantic alignment. Causal-QA is a question-answering-based metric: for each chain, we automatically generate a bank of multiple-choice questions whose answers are determinable only from the intermediate events, and at evaluation time we measure the accuracy of a fixed reader LLM that consumes only the model’s generated chain. Together, these metrics capture both local semantic matching and global causal coherence . We provide two complementary datasets: SF20K-CC , a manually annotated diagnostic benchmark on 20 amateur films from SF20K, and CMD-CC , a larger-scale dataset of movie clips from Condensed Movies with annotations derived from audio description (AD), including train and test splits.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一项新的任务:Causal Chain 世代。 如图所示,给一个视频,一个开始事件,以及一个结束事件,模型必须生成中间事件的序列,从而因果地将两者连接起来. 通过要求无限生成结构化序列,CCG避免了MCQA的捷径问题,同时允许自动评价,这是自由形式开放式QA无法可靠实现的. 我们在开展这项工作的同时,还制定了两个补充性评价指标。 SODA-Embedding扩展了SODA指标Fujita等人(2020年),用语义嵌入取代n格匹配,将焦点从时间定位转移到语义对齐. Causal-QA是一个基于问答的衡量标准:对于每个链条,我们自动生成一个多选择问题的库,其答案只能通过中间事件来决定,在评估时,我们测量只消耗模型生成链条的固定读物LLM的准确性. 这些衡量标准合在一起,既能捕捉本地语义匹配,又能捕捉全球因果一致性。 我们提供了两个互补的数据集:SF20K-CC(SF20K-CC),一个对SF20K的20部业余电影进行人工注释的诊断基准,以及CMD-CC,一个规模更大的Condensed Movies电影剪辑数据集,其说明来源于音频描述(AD),包括列车和测试分片.

blocks.en: Our analysis (Section 5.2 ) reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with causal chain generation: common failure modes include missing critical events, hallucinating non-existent ones, and producing causally incoherent sequences. To establish a strong baseline for future work, we benchmark a recipe combining supervised fine-tuning and GRPO with a composite reward derived directly from our two metrics (Section 4 ), and ablate each component.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析(第5.2节)揭示了最新水平的VLM与因果链生成的挣扎:常见的失败模式包括缺失的关键事件,幻觉不存在的事件,以及产生因果不一致的序列. 为了为今后的工作确定一个强有力的基准,我们以一个方法为基准,将经过监督的微调和GPRO与直接从我们两个衡量标准(第4节)中得出的综合奖励结合起来,并减少每个组成部分。

blocks.en: This paper makes three contributions. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a new task for evaluating narrative causality in videos, and accompany it with two complementary metrics, SODA-Embedding and Causal-QA, and two datasets, SF20K-CC (manually annotated full silent films) and CMD-CC (a larger-scale, AD-derived set of movie clips). We then provide a detailed analysis of state-of-the-art VLMs on the task, highlighting systematic failure modes in causal reasoning. Finally, we establish a strong baseline recipe that combines SFT and GRPO with a composite verifiable reward, ablating the contribution of each reward term to give a reference point for future work on video-based causal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 本文提出三点意见. 我们介绍了Causal Ch链生成(CCG),这是评估视频中叙述因果关系的新任务,并附有两个互补的度量衡,即SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA,以及两个数据集SF20K-CC(人工注释全无声片)和CMD-CC(一个规模更大的AD衍生电影片段). 然后,我们详细分析关于这项任务的最新自愿终止措施,强调因果推理中的系统失效模式。 最后,我们制定了强有力的基准方程式,将SFT和GPRO与可综合核查的奖励结合起来,将每个奖励期的贡献归纳出来,为今后基于视频的因果关系推理工作提供一个参考点。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video reasoning benchmarks. Video understanding benchmarks have evolved from low-level perception such as action recognition Kay et al. (2017) ; Fabian Caba Heilbron and Niebles (2015) toward high-level reasoning. Standard multiple-choice benchmarks Xiao et al. (2021) ; Wu et al. (2021) ; Mangalam et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2024b) drove much of this progress but remain prone to shortcut learning, where models exploit answer-option biases rather than reason over the visual content Foss et al. (2025) . This has motivated work that evaluates the reasoning process itself, from synthetic counterfactual environments Yi et al. (2020) ; Chen et al. (2022) to rationale-based assessments Nagrani et al. (2025) and event-rich narrative benchmarks Parmar et al. (2024) ; Xie et al. (2024) . Some approaches structure causal reasoning explicitly, such as VITED Lu et al. (2025) with evidence chains and MECD Chen et al. (2024b) ; Chen et al. (2025) with video Granger causality, but they treat reasoning as an intermediate step toward a multiple-choice answer. Our task instead makes the causal chain the primary output, which also lets us diagnose the “thinking drift” failure mode of Luo et al. (2025) , where generated reasoning decouples from the visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 视频推理基准. 视频理解基准从低级感知演化,如动作识别Kay等人(2017年);Fabian Caba Heilbron和Niebles(2015年)向高层推理演化. 标准的多重选择基准 Xiao等人(2021年);Wu等人(2021年);Mangalam等人(2023年);Li等人(2024年);Liu等人(2024年);这些进展大多是驱动的,但仍容易采取捷径学习,模型利用答案选择的偏差而不是对视觉内容Foss等人(2025年)的理性. 这激发了评估推理过程本身的工作,从合成反事实环境Yi等人(2020年);Chen等人(2022年)到基于理由的评估Nagrani等人(2025年)和事件丰富的叙事基准Parmar等人(2024年);Xie等人(2024年)。 一些方法明确的结构因果推理,例如有证据链的VITED Lu等人(2025年)和MECD Chen等人(2024年b); Chen等人(2025年)带着视频Granger的因果关系,但他们将推理视为向多选择答案的中间步骤. 相反,我们的任务使因果链成为主要产出,这也使我们能够诊断Luo等人(2025年)的“思维漂移”失败模式,在那里产生的推理与视觉证据脱钩。

blocks.en: Dense video captioning. Dense Video Captioning (DVC) Krishna et al. (2017) ; Yang et al. (2023) is the closest task to ours, as both generate a sequence of event descriptions over a video, but the two differ in fundamental ways. DVC aims for completeness , describing all salient events, whereas CCG requires selectivity , keeping only events causally relevant to a narrative arc. DVC descriptions are typically context-agnostic (“a man picks up an object”), whereas our events are context-dependent (“the detective retrieves the evidence”). DVC is also evaluated by temporal grounding (tIoU) and surface text overlap (CIDEr, METEOR), whereas SODA-Embedding rewards correct reasoning regardless of phrasing and Causal-QA probes causal coherence through a fixed-judge protocol. Audio descriptions Han et al. (2024) are a specialized form of dense captioning for accessibility, capturing narrative-relevant content and serving as a useful training source (Section 4 ), though constrained to dialogue gaps and focused on character identification and atmosphere rather than causal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 低调视频字幕。 Dense Video Caption (DVD) Krishna et al. (2017) ; Yang et al. (2023) 是我们最亲近的任务,因为两者都通过一个视频产生一个事件描述的顺序,但两者在根本上有所不同. DVC的目标是完整性,描述所有突出事件,而CCG则需要选择性,只保留与叙事弧因果相关的事件. DVC描述一般是上下文不可知的(“一个人捡到物品”),而我们的事件则取决于上下文(“侦探取回证据”)。 DVC也通过时间搁浅(tIoU)和表面文本重叠(CIDER,METEOR)来评价,而SODA-Embedding则通过固定判断协议,无论措辞和Causal-QA探测因果一致性,奖励正确推理. 音频描述 Han et al. (2024) 是一种对无障碍性进行密集描述,捕捉叙事相关内容,并充当有用的培训来源(第4节)的专门形式,尽管受限制于对话差距,并注重特征识别和氛围而不是因果推理.

blocks.en: VLM post-training. Post-training has become central to eliciting reasoning in (vision-)language models. Supervised fine-tuning on curated instruction data is a standard first stage Liu et al. (2023) ; Lin et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024a) , and reinforcement learning, in particular Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) Shao et al. (2024) ; Guo et al. (2025) , has shown that reasoning can be amplified without large-scale supervision Lambert (2026) . Such methods are only beginning to reach video Feng et al. (2025) , where designing robust, verifiable rewards remains open. We adopt GRPO and contribute task-specific verifiable rewards, using SODA-Embedding as a dense semantic signal and Causal-QA accuracy as a complementary, more directly causal one.
blocks.zh: VLM 后培训. 后培训已成为(视觉)语言模式推理的核心。 指导数据的监督微调是标准的第一阶段Liu等人(2023年);Lin等人(2023年);Liu等人(2024年a年),以及强化学习,特别是集团相对政策优化(GPRO) Shao et al. (2024); Guo et al. (2025),已经表明推理可以在没有大规模监管的情况下被放大. Lambert (2026). 此类方法才刚开始传到视频Feng等人(2025年),其中设计有力,可核查的奖励仍然开放. 我们采用GRPO,并提供具体任务可核查的奖励,将SODA-Embedding作为密集的语义信号,将Causal-QA精确度作为互补的、更直接的因果关系。

blocks.en: 3 Causal Chain Generation
blocks.zh: 3 因果关系链生成

blocks.en: We now formally introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG). We first define the task (Section 3.1 ), then present two complementary evaluation metrics (Section 3.2 ), and finally describe the construction of the two datasets we release with the task (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们现在正式推出Causal链生成(CCG). 我们首先界定任务(第3.1节),然后提出两个补充评价衡量标准(第3.2节),最后阐述我们随任务而发布的两个数据集的构建情况(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价尺度

blocks.en: We evaluate generated causal chains along two complementary axes: semantic matching , captured by SODA-Embedding (Section 3.2.1 ), and causal coherence , captured by Causal-QA (Section 3.2.2 ). The two metrics target different failure modes: SODA-Embedding rewards correct phrasing and ordering of individual events, while Causal-QA asks whether the chain contains the specific causal details needed to reconstruct the narrative.
blocks.zh: 我们沿着两个互补轴线评价生成的因果关系链:语义匹配(SODA-Embedding捕获)(第3.2.1节)和因果一致性(Causal-QA捕获)(第3.2.2节)。 这两个度量衡针对不同的故障模式:SODA-Embedding奖赏正确了单个事件的措辞和顺序,而Causal-QA则询问链条是否包含重建叙述所需的具体因果细节.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 SODA-Embedding
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 SODA-Embedding (SODA-Embedding) (英语).

blocks.en: SODA-Embedding measures the semantic and sequential quality of a generated chain against a ground-truth reference. It extends the SODA framework Fujita et al. (2020) , originally designed for dense video captioning, with two key modifications. We discard the temporal Intersection-over-Union (tIoU) constraint, since our task prioritizes the logical ordering of events over precise temporal grounding, and align events purely by their semantic and sequential correspondence. We also replace the n-gram matching score (METEOR) with cosine similarity between text embeddings (Qwen3-Embedding), which rewards semantically correct reasoning even when phrased differently from the reference.
blocks.zh: SODA-Embedding对照地面真实性参考,衡量生成链的语义和顺序质量。 它扩展了最初为密集视频字幕设计的SODA框架Fujita et al. (2020),并进行了两个关键修改. 我们放弃了时间跨联盟(tIoU)的制约,因为我们的任务将事件的逻辑顺序放在精确的时间定位之上,并将事件完全根据其语义和顺序的对应来排列。 我们还用文本嵌入式(Qune3-Embedding)之间的余弦相似性来取代n-g匹配分数(METEOR),即使措辞与引用不同,这也奖励了精致正确的推理.

blocks.en: Concretely, given a predicted chain P = ( p 1 , … , p m ) P=(p_{1},\dots,p_{m}) and a ground-truth chain G = ( g 1 , … , g n ) G=(g_{1},\dots,g_{n}) , we compute a pairwise cosine similarity matrix between all event embeddings. We then find the optimal order-preserving alignment through dynamic programming, similar to Dynamic Time Warping, yielding a soft true-positive count. From this, we derive precision (normalized by m m ), recall (normalized by n n ), and report their harmonic mean as the final SODA-Embedding score (full algorithm in the Appendix, with an example in Figure 6 ). This makes the metric robust to paraphrasing (via embeddings), strict on ordering errors (via the sequential alignment), and length-agnostic (via the F1 formulation).
blocks.zh: 具体地说,给一个预测的链条P=(p 1,...,p m) P=(p_{1},\dots,p_{m})和一个地面真实链条G=(g 1,...,g nn) G=(g_{1},\dots,g_{n}),我们计算出所有事件嵌入物之间的对偶共弦相似矩阵. 然后,我们通过动态编程找到最佳的顺序保留对齐,类似于动态时间摇摆(Dynamic Time Warping),产生一个软的真正数. 从中,我们得出精度(正常化为m m),召回(正常化为n n),并将它们的谐波平均值报告为最终的SODA-Embedding得分(完整算法在附录中,图6中有一个例子). 这使得(通过嵌入)的参数强性,严格命令错误(通过顺序对齐)和长度不可知性(通过F1配方)。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Causal-QA
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 因果关系

blocks.en: While SODA-Embedding captures local semantic alignment, it does not directly test whether the generated chain contains the specific causal facts needed to explain the narrative. A chain can be lexically and ordering-wise close to the reference yet still miss or distort the critical causal link. To probe this directly, we introduce Causal-QA, a question-answering–based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 虽然SODA-Embedding捕捉到本地语义对齐,但它并没有直接测试生成的链条是否包含解释叙述所需的具体因果关系. 一个链条在逻辑上和顺序上都可能接近参考文献,但仍然错过或扭曲关键的因果关系。 为了直接探究这个问题,我们引入了Causal-QA,即问答式评估。

blocks.en: Definition. For each ground-truth chain, we associate a small bank of five-way multiple-choice questions (MCQs) whose answers are determinable only from the chain’s intermediate events. At evaluation time, we provide the model’s generated chain as the sole context to a fixed reader LLM and measure its accuracy on the bank. A chain that omits or hallucinates the key causal events will leave the reader unable to recover the answer, resulting in a low score. We show example items in Figure and Appendix C (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 定义。 对于每一条地面真相链,我们把一个由五条道路组成的多选择问题组成的小银行(MCQs)联系起来,这些问题的答案只能从链条的中间事件决定。 在评估时,我们将模型生成的链条作为固定读取器LLM的唯一上下文,并测量其准确性。 一条链条省略或幻觉关键因果事件,会使读者无法恢复答案,导致得分低. 我们在图和附录C中列示实例项目(图7)。

blocks.en: Generation. For each ground-truth chain, a generator LLM (Qwen3.6-27B) proposes 6–10 candidate five-option MCQs (A–E), where option E is always “Cannot be determined from the chain” and the four distractors are drawn from a fixed set of confusion types (e.g., wrong agent, wrong instrument, swapped order, inverted polarity).
blocks.zh: 历代. 对于每个地面真实链,一个生成器LLM(Quen3.6-27B)提出6-10候选五选项MCQ(A-E),其中选项E总是 " 无法从链中确定 " ,而四个分心器是从一组固定的混淆类型(如错误的代理、错误的仪器、互换顺序、颠倒的极性)中抽取的。

blocks.en:
Filtering. A fixed judge LLM (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) then keeps only questions that pass three sequential tests: answerable from the full chain (the judge selects the gold answer given the full chain, removing ill-posed questions), unanswerable with no context (the judge does not select it given no context, removing questions that can be guesses from prior knowledge), and unanswerable from anchors alone (the judge does not select it given only E start E_{\text{start}} and E end E_{\text{end}} , so the question only probes the intermediate chain). Surviving questions form the Causal-QA bank. We perform majority voting over multiple predictions to avoid dropping questions that are answered by chance.
To verify that the surviving questions are well-posed, two annotators answered 150 sampled Causal-QA questions given the full ground-truth chain, i.e. the setting in which the metric operates. Human accuracy reaches 94.2% on average (five-way MCQ, chance 20%) with strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss’ κ = 0.853 \kappa=0.853 ), confirming that the questions are reliably answerable from the chain alone
.

为了核实幸存的问题是否充分存在,两位注释员回答了150个抽样的Causal-QA问题,考虑到完整的地面真实链条,即衡量标准的运作环境。 人类精度平均达到94.2%(五向MCQ,概率为20%),且有强烈的注释者协议(Fleiss ' ob = 0.853\kappa= 0.853),证实仅从链条上就能可靠地回答问题.

blocks.en: Evaluation setup. At evaluation time, we score a generated chain by passing it to the same fixed judge LLM and reporting accuracy across the clip’s Causal-QA MCQs. Crucially, both the judge and the prompt are fixed and disclosed: this gives a calibrated, deterministic reader. This is in contrast to LLM-as-a-judge approaches that are sensitive to model scale and prompt choice Chen et al. (2024a) ; Zheng et al. (2023) ; Panickssery et al. (2024) . We use Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as the fixed judge, decoded greedily, and perform robustness analysis with different model types and sizes (see Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 在评估时,我们通过传递给同一固定法官的LLM和整个片段的Causal-QA MCQs的报告准确性来获得一个生成的链条。 关键的是,法官和及时性都是固定和披露的:这给一个有校准的,决定性的读者. 这与LLM-as-a-judge方法形成对照,后者对模型尺度和及时选择Chen等人(2024a)敏感; 郑等人 (2023年); 潘尼克塞里等人 (2024年). 我们使用 Quen2.5-3B-指令作为固定裁判, 解码贪婪, 并进行强健性分析, 不同的模型类型和大小(见第5.1节).

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集构建

blocks.en: Data sources. We construct two complementary datasets that trade scale against narrative completeness. SF20K-CC is a manually annotated diagnostic set of 20 full silent animation films from SF20K Ghermi et al. (2025) . Being amateur, complete, and dialogue-free, these films limit data contamination, expose long-range causal structure, and remove the dialogue shortcut, at the cost of expensive manual annotation. CMD-CC is a larger dataset built on CMD-AD Han et al. (2024) , providing a sizable pool with reliable chains derived from manual audio descriptions, at the cost of short clips with truncated narrative arcs. CMD-CC is split into a train set (used in Section 4 ) and a test set drawn from disjoint movies, both produced by the same automated pipeline (below), with the test split additionally manually curated to improve annotation quality.
blocks.zh: 数据来源. 我们构建了两个互补的数据集,其交易规模与叙述性完整性相对应。 SF20K-CC是一款手动附加说明的诊断片集,由来自SF20K Ghermi等人(2025)的20部完整无声动画片组成. 这些影片业余、完整和无对话,限制了数据污染,暴露了远距离的因果结构,并删除了对话快捷键,代价是昂贵的人工注释。 CMD-CC是建立在CMD-AD Han等人(2024年)上的一个更大的数据集,提供由人工音频描述衍生出来的可靠链条的庞大的集合,成本是短片段与短片叙事弧. CMD-CC被拆分为一个列车集(用于第4节)和一个从脱节电影中抽取的测试集,两者都由同一个自动管道(以下)生产,测试再手动分割以提高注释质量.

blocks.en: Annotation protocol. Both datasets are built with the same three-step protocol. We first obtain dense audio descriptions (ADs) for every video, writing them manually for the SF20K-CC silent short films and reusing the existing manual ADs of CMD-AD Han et al. (2024) for CMD-CC.
blocks.zh: 注释协议. 两个数据集都是用相同的三步协议构建的. 我们首先为每部视频获取密集的音频描述(AD),为SF20K-CC无声短片手动写作,并重用CMD-AD Han等人(2024)现有的手动AD.

blocks.en:
From these ADs, we prompt a large language model OpenAI (2025) to build a full causal graph over the video’s events; the exact prompt is given in
Figure 13 . We then review this graph and extract causal chains as sub-parts of it, each taking a start event E start E_{\text{start}} and an end event E end E_{\text{end}} together with the intermediate events that causally connect them. For each extracted chain we build the associated Causal-QA bank with the filtering pipeline of Section 3.2.2 , and the CMD-CC test split is additionally manually curated to improve annotation quality.
blocks.zh:
从这些ADs中,我们促使一个大型语言模型OpenAI(2025年)在视频事件上构建一个完整的因果图;确切的提示是在
图13. 然后我们审查这个图表并提取因果链条作为它的子部分,每个开始事件 E start{ start{}和结束事件 E end} 连同因果连接到它们的中间事件。 对于每个提取链,我们用3.2.2节的过滤管道建造了相关的Causal-QA银行,另外还手动对CMD-CC的测试分解进行了处理,以提高注释质量。

blocks.en: Causality types. To ensure coverage of diverse reasoning patterns, we adopt the taxonomy proposed by Hu et al. Hu and Walker (2017) , which distinguishes four types of narrative causality: Physical (Event A physically causes Event B), Motivational (Event A provides the goal or reason for Event B), Psychological (Event A triggers an emotional state change leading to Event B), and Enabling (Event A creates the necessary conditions for Event B to occur). We classify each chain accordingly. Figure 2 shows one example per type, and Appendix M reports the distribution across types and a per-type performance analysis.
blocks.zh: 因果关系类型。 为确保涵盖各种推理模式,我们采纳了胡等人提出的分类法. Hu and Walker (2017)),它区分了四类叙事因果关系: 物理(活动A实际导致活动B),动机(活动A提供活动B的目标或理由),心理(活动A触发导致活动B的情绪状态变化),以及赋能(活动A为活动B的发生创造必要条件). 我们按顺序分类 图2显示每个类型一个实例,附录M报告各类型分布情况和每个类型业绩分析。

blocks.en: Statistics. Table 1 summarizes the two datasets. SF20K-CC-Test comprises 20 full silent short films with 205 manually verified causal chains, and CMD-CC-Test provides 1,031 chains with 2,001 Causal-QA MCQs, drawn from movies disjoint from the 14,175-chain training set. Figure 3 shows the distributions of chain durations and lengths on SF20K-CC.

blocks.en: 4 A training recipe for CCG
blocks.zh: 页:1 CCG培训配方

blocks.en: While current VLMs can identify isolated events, they struggle to assemble them into coherent causal chains. In this section, we describe a training recipe for CCG that we benchmark in Section 5 . The recipe pairs two off-the-shelf ingredients, each tailored to the task: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the CMD-CC train split as a simple baseline, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a composite verifiable reward whose terms correspond directly to our two metrics. We additionally explore test-time scaling in Appendix G . The novelty of this section is not in the choice of algorithms but in the design of the reward signal, which we show is the key driver of performance in Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 虽然目前的VLM可以识别孤立事件,但是它们努力将其组装成连贯的因果链. 在本节中,我们描述了我们在第5节中设定的CCG培训方法。 食谱配对两种现成的配料,每种配料都适合任务:在CMD-CC列车上作为简单的基线进行有监督的微调(SFT),以及组类相对政策优化(GRPO),其复合可核查的奖励,其条件与我们的两个衡量标准直接对应. 我们还在附录G中探索试验时间的缩放。 本节的新奇之处不是选择算法,而是设计奖励信号,我们显示这是第5.4节中表现的关键动力.

blocks.en: 4.1 Supervised fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 4.1 监督微调

blocks.en: As a baseline training recipe, we fine-tune the model to maximize the likelihood of the ground-truth causal chain 𝒞 gt \mathcal{C}_{\text{gt}} via standard cross-entropy (full objective in Appendix D ). SFT is simple and stable, but it penalizes any deviation from the exact phrasing of the reference, even when the generated chain is semantically correct or conveys the same causal coherence in different words. This rigidity is suboptimal for an open-ended task like CCG, motivating the RL-based recipe below.
blocks.zh: 作为基线培训配方,我们微调模型,以通过标准跨线(附录D中的全部目标),最大限度地实现地面-真实因果链C gt\mathcal{C}_{\text{gt}}}的可能性。 SFT是简单而稳定的,但它会惩罚任何偏离参考物准确措辞的行为,即使生成的链条在表征上正确,或者在不同词语中传达相同的因果一致性. 这种僵硬性对于像CCG这样的开放式任务来说是不尽人意的,激发了下面基于RL的配方.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we first validate our SODA-Embedding metric via synthetic perturbations and human correlation (Section 5.1 ). We then benchmark state-of-the-art VLMs on our task (Section 5.2 ), evaluate the training recipe of Section 4 (Section 5.3 ), and ablate the composition of the composite reward (Section 5.4 ).

blocks.en: Agreement with human judgment. We run a pairwise meta-evaluation: an annotator is shown a ground-truth chain g g and two predictions ( p 1 , p 2 p_{1},p_{2} ) and picks the better one, and a metric agrees if the prediction it scores higher is the one preferred. Over 256 stratified A/B pairs (128 CMD-CC, 128 SF20K-CC) with three independent annotators in strong agreement (Fleiss κ = 0.881 \kappa=0.881 ), Figure 5 (bottom) reports each metric’s pairwise agreement. Embedding-based metrics agree with the annotator far more than ngram ones (SODA-E at 79.2% versus 61.8–72.0% for METEOR, CIDEr, and ROUGE-L). Crucially, SODA-E beats its own ngram ablation SODA-C, which has the same alignment method but scores with METEOR (79.2% versus 66.1%): the embedding scorer, not the alignment, is what makes the metric better aligned with human judgment. Moreover, SODA-E improves with the embedder quality and size, going from 76.2% (SODA-E with MiniLM) to 79.2% (SODA-E with Qwen3-Embedding-4B).
blocks.zh: 同意人类的判断 我们运行一个双向元评价:一个注释员被显示一个地面真实链 g 和两个预测(p 1, p 2 \\\ 1}, p\\ 2}) 并选择更好的一个,如果它得分更高的预测是首选的话,一个衡量标准同意。 超过256对分级的A/B配对(128 CMD-CC,128 SF20K-CC),并有3个独立注音员在强烈一致中(Fleiss ob = 0.881\kappa = 0.881),图5(底部)报告每个公尺的对称协议. 嵌入式衡量标准与注释者一致的远不止ngm(SODA-E为79.2%,而METEOR、CIDER和ROUGE-L为61.8-72.0%)。 关键是,SODA-E击败了自己的ngram ablation SODA-C,它具有相同的对齐方法,但与METEOR(79.2%对66.1%)的分数:嵌入计分器而不是对齐,是使该度量更符合人类判断的方法. 此外,SODA-E随着嵌入器的质量和尺寸而改善,从76.2%(SODA-E与迷你LM)提高到79.2%(SODA-E与Qune3-Embedding-4B).

blocks.en: Robustness to the underlying models. Each metric relies on an auxiliary model (SODA-Embedding on a text embedder, Causal-QA on a judge LLM), so we verify that our system rankings are not an artifact of those choices by re-scoring all systems while varying only that model. The rankings are remarkably stable, not only across model sizes but, more importantly, across model families. Swapping the SODA-Embedding embedder from Qwen3-Embedding-4B to its 0.6B/8B variants or to the cross-family all-MiniLM-L6-v2 preserves the system ordering ( ≥ 91 % \geq 91\% rank agreement, Spearman ρ ≥ 0.91 \rho\geq 0.91 ). Causal-QA is just as stable when the judge is competent: a 7B Qwen judge and the cross-family Gemma-3-12B and Llama-3.1-8B judges all reproduce the ranking of our default Qwen2.5-3B judge ( ≥ 85 % \geq 85\% agreement). The only exception is a 0.5B judge, too weak to separate systems, which collapses to near-chance agreement on the smaller SF20K set. We therefore fix Qwen3-Embedding-4B and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and conclude that our findings are robust to these choices (see Table 11 and Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 坚固到基本模型。 每个衡量标准都依赖于一个辅助模型(SODA-Embedding on a text embedder, Causal-QA on a judge LLM),所以我们通过重新评分所有系统,而只改变这个模型,来验证我们的系统排名不是这些选择的产物. 排名非常稳定,不仅跨模型大小,更重要的是跨模型家庭。 将SODA-Embedding嵌入器从Qune3-Embedding-4B到它的0.6B/8B变体,或到跨家庭的全MiniLM-L6-v2,保留了系统订单(\\\ 91%\ 等级协议, Spearman ^ 0.91\rho\geq 0.91). Causal-QA在法官胜任时同样稳定:一名7B的Quen法官和跨家庭的Gemma-3-12B和Llama-3.1-8B法官都照搬了我们默认的Quen2.5-3B法官的排名(≥85%\geq 85\%). 唯一的例外是一名0.5B型裁判员,太弱,无法分离系统,在较小的SF20K套装上,它会崩溃成近距离的协议. 因此,我们修正了Qune3-Embedding-4B和Qune2.5-3B-指示,并得出结论认为,我们的结论对这些选择是强有力的(见表11和附录H)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.2 基线

The reference conditions isolate each input modality: Random shuffles reference chains across test instances, Guessing sees the query alone, Blind adds subtitles but no frames. Video : full video at 1 FPS, or a truncated segment centered on the causal chain (32 frames); the two give comparable scores for the same model (Appendix K ). Subs. : subtitle transcript provided. All models receive the ground-truth number of events. Best per column in bold .

blocks.en: Setup. We benchmark a broad set of systems on SF20K-CC and CMD-CC: open-source VLMs of varying scale, proprietary models, dedicated causal-reasoning baselines, and caption-then-reason pipelines, alongside trivial Random , Guessing , and Blind references (full list, citations, and inference details in Appendix I ). Each model is run on either the full video (1 FPS) or a truncated clip centered on the chain (32 frames). These conditions are comparable (Appendix K ), so all rows share one table. All models receive the subtitle transcript, and metrics use the embedder and judge of Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们以SF20K-CC和CMD-CC为基准制定一套广泛的系统:不同规模的开源甚高频、专有模式、专用的因果理由基线、以及标题和当时理由的管道,以及无关紧要的Random、猜测和盲目参考(完整清单、引用和附录一的推论细节)。 每个型号要么运行在全视频(1 FPS)上,要么以链条(32帧)为中心的短片. 这些条件可以比较(Appendix K ),因此所有行共用一个表. 所有模型都收到字幕记录,衡量标准使用嵌入器和第3.2节的法官。

blocks.en: Scaling behavior. Sweeping the Qwen3.5 family (Appendix J ) shows performance rising steeply with model size up to 4B and then saturating. Even the strongest baseline (27B, 59.9 SODA-Embedding on CMD-CC) leaves substantial headroom, indicating that CCG is far from solved. Returns in the number of input frames are roughly logarithmic, with Causal-QA the more frame-hungry axis.
blocks.zh: 放大行为 扫荡Qwen3.5家族(Appendix J)显示性能随着模型大小达到4B而急剧上升,然后饱和. 即使是最强的基线(27B,59.9 SODA-Embedding on CMD-CC)也留下了大量的头室,表明CCG远未解决. 输入帧数的返回大致为对数,Causal-QA是比较忙于帧的轴.

blocks.en: Trends. Model scale is the single largest factor, with a broadly consistent ordering across the two datasets. The chain-of-thought (“thinking”) variant reaches the best Causal-QA among non-finetuned open models (24.9 / 21.7) but at much lower SODA-Embedding, as its verbose reasoning diverges from the reference. The caption-then-reason pipelines underperform the corresponding single-pass VLM on CMD-CC, indicating that decomposing the task loses causally relevant visual detail. GPT-5.4-mini reaches the highest Causal-QA overall (29.5 / 23.4). Since the full-video and truncated-clip conditions are comparable (Appendix K ) and all models receive the ground-truth number of events, this is a genuine gap. Gemini-3.1-Flash-lite, run in the same constrained regime, matches GPT-5.4-mini on SF20K (56.0 SODA-Embedding, 22.6 Causal-QA).
blocks.zh: 趋势。 模型尺度是最大的单一系数,两个数据集的顺序大体一致。 思维链(“思考”)变体在非纤维开放型号中达到了最佳的Causal-QA(24.9/21.7),但在SODA-Embedding中则低得多,因为它的动词推理与参考词不同。 标题-当时的合理管道在CMD-CC上的对应单路VLM表现不佳,表明拆解任务会失去因果相关的视觉细节. GPT-5.4-mini总体达到最高的Causal-QA(29.5/23.4). 由于全视频和短剪剪切条件可以比较(Appendix K),所有模型都收到地面真实事件数量,这是真正的空白. 双子座-3.1-Flash-lite,在同一受限制的状态下运行,在SF20K(56.0 SODA-Embedding,22.6 Causal-QA)上与GPT-5.4-mini匹配.

blocks.en: Where difficulty lives. Slicing CMD-CC Causal-QA along causality type, chain length, and dialogue availability (Appendix L ) shows that dialogue dominates: models score + 11 +11 to + 20 +20 Causal-QA points higher on with-dialogue clips than on silent ones, and on the former a text-only control rivals the video model. Stripping the subtitle track from Qwen3.5-9B erases this advantage ( − 4.2 -4.2 on CMD-CC), confirming it comes from the transcript. The silent subset, where the text-only baseline collapses, is therefore the more challenging evaluation of visual causal reasoning. Chain length, by contrast, is not a primary difficulty axis.
blocks.zh: 诸难所住之处. 将CMD-CC Causal-QA按照因果关系类型,链长和对话框可用性进行切换(Appendix L)显示对话主导: 模型得分+11+11到+20+20 Causal-QA在与对话的片断上比在无声片段上的分数高,在前者上则有一个文本独控的对手是视频模型. 从Quen3.5-9B中去掉字幕音轨会抹去这个优势(在CMD-CC上为−4.2-4.2),确认它来自笔录. 因此,仅文本基线崩溃的沉默子集,是对视觉因果推理的更具挑战性的评价. 相比之下,链长不是一个主难度轴.

blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 方法执行情况

blocks.en: Setup. We fine-tune the Qwen3.5-9B backbone on our synthetic CMD-AD training chains (Section 3.3 ) in two stages, both LoRA ( r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , on the q/k/v/o projections) for one epoch each. We first run supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the reference chains, then apply GRPO with the composite reward of Equation 1 : R format + R SODA-E + R Causal-QA R_{\text{format}}+R_{\text{SODA-E}}+R_{\text{Causal-QA}} . Videos are decoded at 1 FPS, matching the baseline setup. All metric values use the same judge and embedder as the baselines.

blocks.en: Table 3: Training-algorithm ablation of Qwen3.5-9B: no fine-tuning (Base), SFT, GRPO from the base model, and SFT followed by GRPO. All GRPO runs use the full composite reward. Best per column in bold , second-best underlined .
blocks.zh: 表3:训练-算术减值 Quen3.5-9B:不微调(Base),SFT,GRPO从基模,SFT之后是GRPO. 所有GRPO运行使用全复合奖励. 每栏最好用粗体表示,下划线第二。

blocks.en: Training algorithm. Every fine-tuning improves the base model (Table 3 ). SFT gives the largest chain-quality gain ( + 7.6 +7.6 SODA-Embedding on CMD-CC, to 62.3) but barely moves Causal-QA. GRPO from the base model instead pushes Causal-QA highest (32.2 on CMD-CC, 24.9 on SF20K-CC) at slightly lower SODA-Embedding, since it chases the judge without SFT’s fluency prior. Stacking the two (SFT + GRPO) is best balanced, reaching the top chain quality (63.3 / 57.9 SODA-Embedding) while recovering much of the Causal-QA gain (29.4 on CMD-CC). The two routes thus trade chain quality against causal accuracy, a tension we dissect in the reward ablation below. Because both evaluation metrics are used as rewards during GRPO fine-tuning, we verify these performance gains against a held-out judge: it rises monotonically from the base model through SFT to SFT + GRPO on both test sets (see Table 6 in Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 训练算法. 每一次微调都会改进基础模型(表3). SFT在CMD-CC上给予最大链质量收益(+7.6+7.6 SODA-Embedding),达到62.3,但几乎没有移动Causal-QA. GRPO则将Causal-QA(CMD-CC上为32.2,SF20K-CC上为24.9)推向最高点, 堆叠两种(SFT + GRPO)最为平衡,达到最高链质量(63.3 / 57.9 SODA-Embedding),同时回收大部分Causal-QA增益(CMD-CC上的29.4). 因此,这两条路线的贸易链质量与因果准确性相对照,我们在下面的奖励中解析出一种紧张。 由于在GRPO微调期间,两个评价衡量标准都被用作奖励,因此我们对照被搁置的法官核实这些业绩收益:在两个测试组上,通过SFT从基模型单调上升至SFT+GRPO(见附录E表6)。

blocks.zh: 5.4 奖励减少

blocks.en:

Arms that include R Causal-QA R_{\text{Causal-QA}} are trained on the subset of clips with a Causal-QA bank ( 𝒟 train QA-only \mathcal{D}_{\text{train}}^{\text{QA-only}} ), while the remaining arms use the full chain set, and evaluation is identical across all arms.
Results are reported in Table 4 , with the non-fine-tuned base model as a reference point.

blocks.en: Interpretation. The reward you optimize is the metric you win. Format-only ( ✓ \checkmark F) regresses below the base model on every metric, since it enforces valid JSON but supplies no content signal. Adding R SODA-E R_{\text{SODA-E}} ( ✓ \checkmark F ✓ \checkmark S) yields the largest SODA-Embedding gain (the highest in the table on both datasets: 60.1 on CMD-CC and 58.8 on SF20K-CC), as expected since it is essentially its own loss. Adding R Causal-QA R_{\text{Causal-QA}} ( ✓ \checkmark F ✓ \checkmark C) instead maximizes Causal-QA, reaching 37.8 on CMD-CC (the highest Causal-QA of any open-weights configuration we trained), but at lower SODA-Embedding. The full reward ( ✓ \checkmark F ✓ \checkmark S ✓ \checkmark C) is the best-balanced arm, recovering most of the SODA-Embedding of the SODA-only run while retaining most of the Causal-QA of the QA-only run. The two semantic terms are thus complementary rather than redundant, each binding the metric it targets.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We introduced Causal Chain Generation , a new task targeting narrative causality in videos, together with two complementary metrics ( SODA-Embedding , an embedding-based extension of the SODA framework capturing semantic matching, and Causal-QA , a question-answering probe of causal coherence) and two datasets: SF20K-CC , a small but contamination-controlled diagnostic over full silent films, and CMD-CC , a larger-scale AD-derived dataset with train and test splits. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with causal coherence, especially over long event sequences. We also established a strong baseline recipe, combining SFT and GRPO with a composite verifiable reward derived from our metrics, as a reference point for future work on this open challenge.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Causal链生成(Causal chain Generation),这是一项针对视频中叙述性因果关系的新任务,以及两个互补的度量衡(SODA-Embedding),一个基于嵌入的SODA框架扩展,捕获语义匹配,另一个是Causal-QA,一个因果一致性的问答探针)和两个数据集:SF20K-CC,一个是小型但受污染控制的诊断,对全无声片,以及CMD-CC,一个规模更大的AD-衍生数据集,配有列车和测试分. 我们的分析表明,最新水平的VLM在因果一致性方面挣扎,特别是在长时间的事件序列方面。 我们还制定了强有力的基准方程式,将SFT和GPRO与从我们的衡量标准中得出的可核查的综合奖励结合起来,作为今后应对这一公开挑战工作的参照点。

blocks.en: More broadly, the persistent gap between chain quality and causal accuracy suggests that dense captioning and causal understanding remain distinct capabilities, a distinction our task and metrics are explicitly designed to measure and that we hope will guide future work.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,链条质量和因果准确性之间长期存在的差距表明,密集的标题和因果理解仍然是独特的能力,我们的任务和衡量标准显然是用来衡量的,我们希望这将指导今后的工作。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Benchmark scale and domain. SF20K-CC is relatively small (20 silent animated short films, 205 chains), so per-split and per-type estimates have limited statistical power. CMD-CC is larger but consists of short clips with truncated narrative arcs.
blocks.zh: 基准规模和领域。 SF20K-CC相对较小(20部无声动画短片,205个链片),因此每集和每类估计的统计力有限. CMD-CC较大但由短片片段组成,带有短片叙事弧.

blocks.en:
Metrics depend on auxiliary models. SODA-Embedding relies on a frozen text embedder and Causal-QA on a frozen judge LLM. We show that rankings are stable across embedders and across judges of 3B–8B parameters (including cross-family), but absolute scores are model-dependent, and a
weak judge ( ≤ \leq 0.5B) fails to discriminate. Results should therefore be read as relative comparisons under the disclosed, fixed embedder and judge, not as absolute capabilities.
blocks.zh:
量子依赖于辅助模型. SODA-Embedding依赖于冷冻文本嵌入器,Causal-QA依赖于冷冻法官LLM. 我们显示,在嵌入者之间和在3B-8B参数(包括跨家庭)的评委之间,排名是稳定的,但绝对分数取决于模型,并且
弱法官(\\leq 0.5B)没有歧视。 因此,结果应理解为在披露、固定嵌入和判断下进行比较,而不是绝对能力。

blocks.en:
Partial human validation. We validate two components with human annotators: the metric–human agreement study, and the answerability of Causal-QA questions given the full chain
. However, we do not report human performance on the CCG task itself.
blocks.zh:
部分人类验证. 我们用人类的注释来验证两个组成部分: 衡量 - 人类协议研究, 和Causal - QA问题的答案,因为全链
。 。 。 然而,我们不报告人类在CCG任务本身方面的表现。

blocks.en: In this section, we provide the detailed pseudo-code for our proposed SODA-Embedding metric. This metric evaluates the semantic and structural quality of generated causal chains by finding an optimal, order-preserving alignment between the predicted sequence and the ground truth in a semantic embedding space. Figure 6 illustrates the computation on a small example.

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the two training objectives explored in our work: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We provide the mathematical formulations to highlight the fundamental difference in how they optimize the model’s reasoning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详述了我们在工作中探讨的两个培训目标: 监督精选(SFT)和集团相对政策优化(GRPO). 我们提供数学公式来强调它们如何优化模型推理能力的根本区别。

blocks.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). The SFT baseline optimizes the model to maximize the likelihood of the exact ground-truth token sequence. This rigidity is suboptimal for open-ended causal reasoning tasks.

blocks.en: A natural concern with GRPO fine-tuning is that improvements on SODA-Embedding and Causal-QA could partly reflect optimization against the reward signal itself, rather than a genuine improvement in causal-chain reasoning. To assess this, we evaluate all models with a held-out LLM judge (GPT-5.6-Luna) that scores each response on a 0–5 scale and is never used as a reward signal during training.
blocks.zh: 对GRPO微调的一个自然关切是,改进SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA可以部分反映与奖励信号本身相比的优化,而不是真正改善因果链推理。 为了评估这一点,我们用一个被搁置的LLM裁判员(GPT-5.6-Luna)来评价所有模型,该裁判员按0比5的比例评分,在训练期间从未被用作奖励信号.

blocks.en: Table 4 in the main paper reports the reward ablation for GRPO trained directly from the base model. For completeness, Table 7 reports the full ablation for both initializations, GRPO from scratch (no SFT) and GRPO on top of the SFT-merged model, under all four reward compositions, using a converged 8,192-example training budget. The two initializations specialize in opposite directions. From scratch, the Causal-QA reward drives the highest causal accuracy anywhere (37.8 Causal-QA on CMD-CC, with the SODA-E reward added back recovering chain quality at a small accuracy cost), since the policy chases the judge without a fluency prior. The SFT initialization instead yields the best chain quality (up to 63.3 SODA-E) but caps the Causal-QA gains, as the penalty toward the fluent SFT policy keeps chains well-formed yet prevents aggressive judge-chasing. Across both, format-only GRPO regresses below its initialization on both metrics, confirming that the semantic reward terms, not the format constraint, are what drive the gains.

Causal-QA is equally stable whenever the judge is competent: the 7B Qwen judge and the two cross-family judges (Llama-3.1-8B and the 2025 Gemma-3-12B) reproduce the 3B reference ranking at ≥ 85 % \geq 85\% agreement. The lone exception is the 0.5B judge, whose accuracy is nearly flat across systems (close to the one-in-five chance band), so it cannot discriminate and falls to near-chance agreement ( ρ ≈ 0 \rho\approx 0 ) on the smaller SF20K set. We therefore adopt Qwen3-Embedding-4B and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.

blocks.en: Appendix I Baseline setup
blocks.zh: 附录一 基线设置

blocks.en: We evaluate four families of systems with SODA-Embedding and Causal-QA: (i) end-to-end VLMs of varying scale (the Qwen3.5-VL family, 0.8B–27B Team (2025) , GLM-4.6V-flash GLM-V Team (2025) , and InternVL-3.5-8B Wang et al. (2025b) ); (ii) proprietary models (GPT-5.4-nano/mini OpenAI (2025) ); (iii) causal-reasoning baselines (a chain-of-thought “thinking” variant, MECD Chen et al. (2024b) , and TEMPURA-3B Cheng et al. (2025) ); and (iv) two-stage caption-then-reason pipelines. Each model is run under one of two input conditions: the full video sampled at 1 FPS, or a truncated clip centered on the causal chain from which we sample 32 frames ( ≈ \approx 1 FPS over the clip). Open-weights models use the full video; the proprietary GPT-5.4 and Gemini models are restricted to the truncated-clip condition by API constraints (the two conditions are comparable, see Appendix K ). All models receive the clip’s subtitle transcript and the ground-truth number of events. We further report three trivial references: Random , a shuffled chain over a generic event vocabulary; Guessing , a text LLM given only the query; and Blind , a text LLM given only the subtitle transcript and no frames. Metric values use Qwen3-Embedding-4B (SODA-Embedding) and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (Causal-QA), in line with Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四个带有SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA的系统:(一) 不同规模的端到端的VLM(Quen3.5-VL家族,0.8B–27B团队(2025),GLM-4.6V-flash GLM-V团队(2025),以及InternVL-3.5-8B). Wang等人(2025年b)); (二)专有型号(GPT-5.4-nano/mini OpenAI(2025年)); (三)因果合理基线(思维链式“思维”变体,MECD) Chen等人(2024年b)和TEMPURA-3B Cheng等人(2025年);和(四)两级字幕-当时的理由管道。 每个模型在两个输入条件中的一个下运行:以1 FPS为样本的完整视频,或以32帧(QQ\约1 FPS在片段之上)为样本的因果链为中心的短片. 开放量级模型使用全视频;专有的GPT-5.4和双子座模型受API限制限制限制为短程-clip条件(这两个条件可比较,见附录K). 所有模型都收到剪辑的字幕记录和事件的地面真实数量。 我们进一步报告三个无关紧要的参考:随机,一个在一般事件词汇上被打乱的链条;猜测,一个只给出查询的文本LLM;和盲,一个只给出字幕记录的文本LLM,没有帧. 计量值使用Qune3-Embedding-4B(SODA-Embedding)和Qune2.5-3B-指令(Causal-QA),与第3.2节一致.

blocks.en: Figure 9 sweeps two axes for the Qwen3.5-VL family on the full video. With model size, performance rises steeply up to 4B and then largely saturates—SODA-Embedding climbs from 18.0/20.8 (0.8B) to 53.3/53.2 (4B) on SF20K-CC/CMD-CC, with only marginal gains beyond. blocks.en: Our proprietary baselines are restricted by API limits to a truncated clip centered on the causal chain (32 sampled frames), whereas open-weights models see the full video at 1 FPS. To verify this does not confound the comparison, we run the same backbone (Qwen3.5-VL-9B, with subtitles) under both conditions (Table 12 ). The two conditions differ by at most ∼ \sim 2 points on either metric and either test set, and leave the system ranking unchanged. We therefore treat the full-video and truncated-clip conditions as comparable and place all baselines in a single table (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的专有基线被API限制在以因果链(32个采样框)为中心的短短片中,而开放量级模型则在1 FPS中看到完整视频. 为了核实这一点并没有混淆比较,我们在两个条件下运行相同的骨干(Quen3.5-VL-9B,带有字幕(表12)). 这两个条件在测量和测试组合上最多相差 \ sim 2 点,系统排名保持不变。 因此,我们将全视频和短剪剪切条件视为可比条件,并将所有基线放在一个表格中(表2)。

blocks.en: Appendix L Difficulty breakdown
blocks.zh: 附录 难度 细目

blocks.en: Figure 10 slices CMD-CC Causal-QA along three axes, comparing GPT-5.4-mini, Qwen3.5-VL-9B with subtitles, and a text-only control that sees the subtitles but no frames. Causality types follow a stable hardness ordering across all models, with consequence the hardest and motivation the easiest among the well-populated types, while counterfactual appears easy but rests on very few questions (29 on CMD-CC) and is exploitable by the judge, so we read it with caution. Performance is essentially flat in chain length, with neither metric decaying from short to long chains. Most strikingly, dialogue availability dominates: every model that sees subtitles scores + 11 +11 to + 20 +20 Causal-QA points higher on with-dialogue clips than on silent ones, and on with-dialogue clips the text-only control rivals the video model. Stripping the subtitle track from Qwen3.5-VL-9B erases this advantage entirely ( − 4.2 -4.2 on CMD-CC), confirming it comes from the subtitle text rather than from dialogue clips being intrinsically easier to watch.
blocks.zh: 图10 CPD-CC Causal-QA沿三轴切片,比较GPT-5.4-mini,Qwen3.5-VL-9B带字幕,以及只看到字幕但没有帧的文本控制. 因果关系类型在所有模型中都遵循稳定的硬度顺序,结果,最困难和动机最容易在人口众多的类型中出现,而反事实似乎容易,但依赖于极少数问题(CMD-CC上有29个问题),并且可以被法官利用,因此我们谨慎地阅读。 性能在链长上基本上是平的,没有从短链到长链的计量衰变. 最引人注目的是,对话的可用性占主导地位:每个看到字幕分数+11+11到+20+20的模型Causal-QA在与对话的片段比无声的片段得到更高的分数,在与对话的片段上,只文本控制片段与视频模型竞争. 从Quen3.5-VL-9B中去掉字幕音轨,完全抹去这一优势(在CMD-CC上为−4.2-4.2),证实它来自字幕文本,而不是对话片段在本质上比较容易观看.

Causal-QA accuracy on CMD-CC sliced by (a) causality type, (b) gold chain length, and (c) dialogue availability, for GPT-5.4-mini, Qwen3.5-9B (full video with subtitles), and a text-only control that sees the subtitles but no frames. Dialogue is the sharpest axis: silent movies are significantly harder to understand.

blocks.en: Appendix N Success and failure cases
blocks.zh: 附录N 成败案例

blocks.en: We present a qualitative analysis of the baselines performance using examples from GPT-4.1-mini, as illustrated in Figure 11 . These examples highlight both the emerging reasoning capabilities of VLMs and their persistent limitations in tracking specific causal mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 如图11所示,我们利用GPT-4.1-mini的实例,对基线业绩进行了定性分析。 这些例子突出表明了自愿终止措施新出现的推理能力及其在跟踪具体因果机制方面持续存在的局限性。

blocks.en:
Success cases. In the first example (Row 1), the model successfully identifies the use of the stretcher as a physical solution for crossing the gap.
In the second example (Row 2), the model understands the key reason, the vending machine getting stuck, that drives the man to hit the vending machine.
blocks.zh:
成功的案例。 在第一个例子(Row 1)中,模型成功识别了担架作为跨越缺口的物理解决方案的使用.
在第二例(Row 2)中,该型号理解了关键原因,自动售货机被卡住了,这驱使男子撞击自动售货机.

blocks.en:
Failure cases. Despite these successes, the model frequently struggles with complex visual causalities, often resorting to generic events or hallucinations.
In the third example (Row 3), the model does not notice the brief action that leads to the helicopter falling from the mountain ( “The rescue worker hits the helicopter’s propellers with his skis” ); instead, it generates a generic event ( “The helicopter takes off and approaches the mountain” ), making the subsequent crash logically inexplicable.
In the fourth example (Row 4), the model fails to connect the inattentiveness of the driver looking for cigarettes and near collision with another car, causing the driver to suddenly and violently brake, making him sick and causing him to vomit inside his car. Instead, it hallucinates a completely unrelated event: “The man finds cigarettes and lights one but suddenly the tire of his car bursts” . This illustrates a tendency for models to generate events that are logically plausible but not grounded in the video content.
blocks.zh:
失败案例。 尽管取得了这些成功,该模型经常与复杂的视觉因果关系发生斗争,经常诉诸于一般事件或幻觉.
在第三个例子(Row 3)中,模型没有注意到导致直升机从山上坠落的短暂行动( " 救援人员用滑雪机击中直升机的螺旋桨 " );相反,它产生了一个通用事件( " 直升机起飞并接近山上 " ),使随后的坠机在逻辑上无法解释。
在第四例(Row 4)中,该型号未能连接司机寻找香烟的不耐烦性,并接近与另一辆车碰撞,导致司机突然暴力刹车,使他生病,并导致他呕吐在车内. 相反,它产生了一个完全无关的事件: “这名男子发现香烟和灯光,但突然他的汽车轮胎爆裂”。 这表明,模型往往会产生一些符合逻辑但并非基于视频内容的事件。
